tickets.text: I do not adopt this. The trigger is yesterday's high (h1_close_above:bar_high) while D sits 2.45 under the 20-bar high and H1 is 9<21: that loads under the pivot, not through it (C5). My method buys the break of the 48.61 swing high on rising volume, back over the hourly averages. My objection stands and the draft carries none of my lines.
